Landmarks named as you pass, labelled on your camera in Window View, and the best side to sit

page.title: AirReveal by iSafeNet: See What You're Flying Over
page.description: AirReveal is an offline flight map for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch that names the landmarks below your plane, shows the way ahead in Pilot View, tells you which side to look from, reveals the planes flying over you, and keeps your flight journal.
page.lead: Ever looked out of the window and wondered what's down there? AirReveal places your plane on a live map using your device's GPS, names the landmarks, cities and natural wonders below and ahead, shows the way ahead as if from the flight deck, labels what's outside on your camera, and tells you the best side to sit. On the ground, it reveals every plane flying over you. It works without in-flight Wi-Fi, and keeps every trip in your flight journal.
features: Your position from GPS alone, with the landmarks, cities and natural wonders below named as you pass. Maps download before take-off, so it works in airplane mode.
The way ahead as if from the flight deck: your downloaded map as the ground, glass tapes for real speed, altitude and heading from the GPS, the forecast cloud along your route, and the places ahead.
When you add a flight, AirReveal tells you which window to book, the landmarks you'll see from it and whether you'll catch the sunrise or sunset.
Hold your phone up to the plane window and the landmarks outside are labelled on the camera picture. It works offline.
Three quick questions about each landmark, bingo for the whole row, achievements and a passport.
Save every flight, collect the places you've seen and build a personal map of your travels.
Altitude, speed and heading on the map, and on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while you fly.
On the ground, every aircraft overhead on a radar, a map and your camera, with police and air-ambulance helicopters in their colours, a Spotter's Logbook and alerts for aircraft you're watching for.
page.platforms_heading: Native on every screen it runs on.
platforms: A comfortable view on iPhone, a wide flight map on iPad, and the planes above you on your wrist.
Flight progress on the Lock Screen and Home Screen.
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.
Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftData, CoreLocation, MapLibre, WeatherKit, CloudKit, WidgetKit, ActivityKit and StoreKit.
page.pricing: Free to plan and preview flights and to take your first Live-tracked flight. AirReveal Pro unlocks continued Live GPS tracking and the full in-flight experience.
page.good_to_know: AirReveal uses your location only to place you on the map during a flight. It isn't an official flight-status or aviation-safety service, so always follow your airline and crew.
page.learn_more: AirReveal has its own website, with a full user guide, support and policies.
